default_creds.context: Credentials provider 'InsecureSignin' ships in the Next.js signin page (next/src/pages/signin.tsx). When NODE_ENV is not hardened or NEXTAUTH_SECRET is not set, the page renders 'Sign in with username (Insecure)' -- username-only login, no password validation, signIn('credentials', {name: usernameValue}) with zero auth. This is intentional dev scaffolding that reaches production in unmanaged deploys.

MySQL 8.0 database credentials hardcoded in docker-compose.yml: MYSQL_USER, MYSQL_PASSWORD, MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD all set to 'reworkd_platform'. DB exposed on host port 3308 (container port 3307). REWORKD_PLATFORM_DB_PASS=reworkd_platform also set in the platform service environment.

install_tell: docker-compose up (Next.js frontend :3000 + FastAPI platform :8000 + MySQL :3308); no public Docker Hub image -- local build from source
misconfig_patterns: NEXTAUTH_SECRET is OPTIONAL in development (schema marks it non-required outside production) -- dev deployments exposed to internet have no session integrity
InsecureSignin credentials provider renders when NODE_ENV is not 'production', allowing any-username/no-password login
NEXT_PUBLIC_FF_MOCK_MODE_ENABLED=true bypasses real agent execution (LLM calls mocked) -- confirms the flag is a runtime bypass surface
FastAPI platform backend likely exposes /docs (Swagger UI) and /redoc in dev mode (REWORKD_PLATFORM_RELOAD=true default)
MySQL hardcoded creds reworkd_platform/reworkd_platform on port 3308 -- if DB port is internet-exposed, full agent run history and credentials accessible
GET /api/agent/tools returns JSON with literal '"color":"TODO: Change to image of tool"' -- vendor-unique dev artifact confirms unhardened deploy
OPENAI_API_KEY, REPLICATE_API_KEY, SERP_API_KEY, PINECONE_API_KEY stored server-side but retrievable if FastAPI /docs endpoint is open

passive: http.html:"TODO: Change to image of tool"

active_probe.false_positive_check: The string '"color":"TODO: Change to image of tool"' is a vendor-unique literal hardcoded in the AgentGPT source. Any response containing this string is a confirmed unhardened deploy. However, this endpoint may be client-rendered (Next.js SPA) and absent from Shodan SSR. Fallback: http.title:"AgentGPT" (9 hits) is the most reliable passive signal. http.html:"reworkd" (4 hits) is the most distinctive -- lowest FP risk. Port 3000 deploys are near-absent in current population; current hits are predominantly frontend-only (backend :8000 refused or closed).

shodan_dorks.note: http.html:"agentgpt" = 12 hits, all HTTP 200, zero 401. http.html:"reworkd" = 4 hits (most distinctive, lowest FP risk). http.title:"AgentGPT" = 9 hits. Bare banner 'AgentGPT' = 0 (no self-identifying response header). Port 3000 as sole qualifier is dead in current population -- current live hits are predominantly reverse-proxied (80/443) or frontend-only. '"TODO: Change to image of tool"' is the highest-confidence active discriminator but is client-rendered, invisible to Shodan SSR (returns 0 on Shodan, use as active-probe confirm only).

GET /signin renders 'Sign in with username (Insecure)' button when credentials provider is active
GET /api/agent/tools returns JSON with '"color":"TODO: Change to image of tool"' vendor literal
MySQL on nonstandard port 3307 (container) / 3308 (host) rather than default 3306
FastAPI /docs (Swagger UI) on :8000 exposed in dev/reload mode
NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_ENV presence in page source indicates Vercel-native or Vercel-mimicking deployment
pivot_paths: GET /api/agent/tools -> enumerate available agent tools (confirms unhardened deploy via TODO literal)
GET /api/agent/tasks -> list stored agent task history (prior runs, user prompts, outputs)
GET /docs on :8000 -> FastAPI Swagger UI exposes full platform API surface without auth in dev mode
GET /api/auth/session -> confirm session state and NextAuth config (no NEXTAUTH_SECRET = invalid session)
MySQL :3308 reworkd_platform/reworkd_platform -> full agent run history, user accounts, stored LLM outputs (read-only enumerate, do not modify)
GET /redoc on :8000 -> alternative API documentation endpoint confirming backend is reachable
auth_evidence: Two independent auth bypass surfaces confirmed from source. (1) InsecureSignin component in next/src/pages/signin.tsx: credentials provider renders 'Sign in with username (Insecure)' button when providers.credentials is truthy -- signIn('credentials', {name: usernameValue}) with no password field, no validation. The button's own label documents the insecurity. (2) NEXTAUTH_SECRET is schema-marked non-required outside production in next/src/env/schema.mjs -- dev deployments exposed to internet have no session integrity guarantee. Survey population (2026-06-19): http.title:"AgentGPT" returned 9 hits, all HTTP 200, zero HTTP 401; http.html:"agentgpt" = 12 hits, zero 401; http.html:"reworkd" = 4 hits, zero 401. All confirmed hits were frontend-only (backend :8000 refused), so API surface unverified on live hosts -- auth bypass is software-default characterization, not confirmed against live backends in this survey round.
sensitive_assets: Agent task history and user prompts stored in MySQL (reworkd_platform DB) -- accessible via hardcoded DB creds on :3308
OpenAI/Replicate/SERP/Pinecone API keys stored server-side in platform environment -- LLMjacking surface if FastAPI /docs is open
Pinecone vector store contents (PINECONE_API_KEY/INDEX/ENVIRONMENT) if configured
User account data via NextAuth database (DATABASE_URL) -- any-username login means account takeover without password
Agent execution logs and intermediate outputs readable via /api/agent/tasks
Helicone API key (HELICONE_API_KEY) -- LLM observability platform credential, exposes full prompt/response logs for the operator
